samples.question: Every panel holds one upright dark bar and one flat orange rod. A panel's reading is how many times its own rod's length fits into its own bar's height. The magenta-framed panel at the top has a reading too. Exactly one of the five panels along the bottom, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right, has the same reading as the framed panel. Bars and rods are not drawn to any shared scale, so only a panel's own rod measures its own bar. Which numbered panel matches the framed panel's reading? Answer with exactly one of: panel-1, panel-2, panel-3, panel-4, panel-5.
